translations.title: Vitamin D, E and C Complex Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to supply vitamins D, E and C during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, low energy during and after illness, the growth period and old age; to relieve peripheral circulation problems and cold hands and feet; to relieve skin pigmentation such as melasma and freckles; and to help prevent bleeding of the gums and nose.
translations.usage: Children aged 12 or older and adults take one tablet twice a day.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you are hypersensitive, if you are hypersensitive to soybean oil, soy or peanuts, if you have high blood calcium, kidney disease or kidney stones, or if the child is under 3 months old. If you are prone to blood clots or are taking estrogen-containing contraceptives, consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Nutritional supply and circulation, peripheral circulation, skin pigmentation, prevention of gum and nose bleeding
summaryTable.Who should be careful: High blood calcium, kidney stones; soy hypersensitivity
summaryTable.Why this one: A vitamin D, E and C complex tablet
